data.name: PageIntro
data.value: Messages sent to an intake channel become pending calls. A dispatcher reviews each one and chooses who to send it to; intake never dispatches anyone by itself.

data.name: FeatureOff
data.value: Intake channels are not turned on for your department yet. You can set channels up now; they start creating calls once the feature is turned on.

data.name: NoChannels
data.value: No intake channels have been set up yet.

data.name: NameHelp
data.value: Shown on the pending calls this channel creates, for example "Hospital transfer line".

data.name: ModeHelp
data.value: Call template reads the message with one of your call email formats. Enhanced AI saves the message as a pending call, then fills in the call type, address, priority and a summary (needs the Enhanced AI add-on with AI intake).

data.name: AllowedSendersHelp
data.value: Comma-separated: phone numbers (with * wildcards), email addresses or @domains, or platform user IDs. Leave blank to accept anyone who can reach the address.

data.name: SendAcknowledgementHelp
data.value: Sends a short receipt with the call number. Texts are answered from the main Resgrid number.

data.name: DeleteConfirm
data.value: Delete this intake channel? Messages sent to its address will no longer create calls.

data.name: Error.InvalidAddress
data.value: That address is not valid for this channel type.

data.name: Error.AddressInUse
data.value: That address is already used by another intake channel or by a department's dispatch email address.

data.name: Error.NameRequired
data.value: Enter a name for the channel.

data.name: Error.Invalid
data.value: The channel could not be saved. Check the values and try again.

data.name: Error.InvalidSenders
data.value: List at most 200 allowed senders, each at most 256 characters, separated by commas or new lines. The channel was not saved.

data.name: Help.Sms
data.value: The department's private inbound dispatch number in international format, for example +17755550100. That number creates its own channel when it is set up.

data.name: Help.Voice
data.value: The department's private inbound dispatch number in international format. Callers who are not members are taken through spoken questions by Enhanced AI voice intake.

data.name: Help.Email
data.value: The part before the @. Email sent to that name at {0} becomes a pending call. It must differ from your department's dispatch email address.

data.name: Help.WhatsApp
data.value: The WhatsApp sender number in international format. Resgrid support registers the sender on Resgrid's Twilio account.

data.name: Help.Slack
data.value: Workspace ID/channel ID, for example T012ABCDE/C034FGHIJ. Invite the Resgrid app to the channel with /invite @Resgrid, then copy the channel ID from the channel details and the workspace ID from About this workspace.

data.name: Help.Teams
data.value: Tenant ID/channel ID, for example 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47/19:abc123@thread.tacv2. Add the Resgrid app to the team and use Get link to channel: the channel ID is the 19:…@thread.tacv2 part and the tenant ID is the tenantId value. Mention @Resgrid in the channel to send a request.

data.name: Help.Telegram
data.value: The chat ID; group IDs are negative, for example -1001234567890. Add the Resgrid bot to the group. With privacy mode on, start a request with /intake or mention the bot.

data.name: Help.Discord
data.value: The channel ID (turn on Developer Mode, right-click the channel, Copy Channel ID). Add the Resgrid app to the server and use /resgrid in the channel.

data.name: Help.GoogleChat
data.value: The space name from the space URL, for example spaces/AAAAbCdEfGh. Add the Resgrid app to the space and mention it to send a request.

data.name: Help.Webhook
data.value: Resgrid creates the webhook URL and signing secret when you save. Any system that can send a signed HTTPS request can create calls.

data.name: ChatRules
data.value: In a linked chat every new message is a request; replies in a thread count only when they mention Resgrid. Direct messages to the Resgrid bot work as before.

data.name: WebhookSecretOnce
data.value: Copy the secret now. It is shown only this once; rotate it if it is lost.

data.name: WebhookNoSecret
data.value: No signing secret is set, so every request is refused. Rotate the secret to create one.

data.name: RotateConfirm
data.value: Rotate the signing secret? The current secret stops working immediately.

data.name: WebhookSigning
data.value: Sign each request with the header X-Resgrid-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body" using the secret>. Requests more than {0} seconds old are refused.

data.name: WebhookBody
data.value: The body is JSON: message (required), subject, sender, externalId (a repeat with the same ID never creates a second call), address, latitude and longitude.

data.name: TextSettingsIntro
data.value: Intake channels turn texts, emails, chat messages and webhook requests into pending calls.

data.name: BlockedSendersIntro
data.value: Senders a dispatcher dismissed as spam. Their texts and calls to your intake channels are recorded but create no calls, and nothing is sent back to them. A block ends by itself on the date shown.

data.name: UnblockConfirm
data.value: Unblock this sender? Their messages will create pending calls again.

data.name: DismissConfirm
data.value: Dismiss this call as spam? It is cancelled and nobody is notified.

data.name: DismissBlockSender
data.value: Also block the sender for {0} days

data.name: Dismissed
data.value: The call was dismissed as spam.

data.name: DismissedAndBlocked
data.value: The call was dismissed as spam and the sender is blocked.

data.name: DismissedNotBlockable
data.value: The call was dismissed as spam. The caller withheld their number, so they could not be blocked.

data.name: DismissNotPending
data.value: This call is no longer pending, so it cannot be dismissed as spam.

data.name: DismissFailed
data.value: The call could not be dismissed right now and is still pending. Try again.

data.name: BlockedSendersUnavailable
data.value: The blocked senders list could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

data.name: Screening.LikelyNotIncident
data.value: Enhanced AI: likely not an incident

data.name: Screening.RepeatSender
data.value: Repeat sender: over the hourly limit

data.name: CadUpdatesHelp
data.value: An email carrying the CAD call ID of a call the department already has updates that call instead of creating a pending call.

data.name: CadUpdatesUnavailable
data.value: Turn on Updates from your CAD first.
